name: Hitozuma Dorei Injoku Choukyou
original_name: 人妻奴隷 淫辱調教
source:
Unable to disobey her husband's commands, the wife is subject to all sorts of sexual insult as he trains her. Slowly, she turns into a sex slave ruled by lust.

The wife takes the greatest pleasure from being controlled. In this adventure game, you get to play with her body in a training chamber filled with lust and desire.
